source.name: The 14 flat creative items ported verbatim plus a 36-item CONSTRAINT-ADHERENCE tier (cre-h01..36) targeting the measured failure mode of creative work: silently dropping an explicit constraint (line counts, word/character caps, forbidden words, required inclusions, form, ending rule, audience, speaker rules). Each new prompt carries 3-6 explicit, mechanically checkable constraints and its rubric enumerates every one as a numbered criterion plus one craft criterion; where facts must appear, the rubric restates them verbatim so the judge holds the answer key. Forms span haiku sequences, 14-line and free-verse poems, acrostics, micro-fiction under word caps, naming and taglines, dialogue with speaker rules, letters/toasts/speeches, original song structures, riddles with fixed answers, children's openings, mood rewrites, second-person and no-adjective prose, and long flash fiction. All names, places and brands are invented.
